description: Land Title Settlement Dept. - Niwandama, Ja-ela D/S Division, Gampaha District - (25/0300)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, including declarations of title determination for specific land parcels, ownership details, property boundaries, and land registration particulars. It falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category as it focuses on land and property-related administrative matters rather than government personnel, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
